name: ais-vision-systems_carousel-defects-cartons-opticais_en_2026-10-29
copy: OPTICAIS supports batch and date checks against the expected text. These samples show a missing mark and ink streaking across the characters. The code comparison shows the same reference marking and its smudged variant; it is not a system reading or a measured result. Send us samples of your packaging and the marking you need to check.

shots.headline: The bottom one:|smudged code
shots.alt: Two windows of the same code: separate characters above and horizontal ink streaks across them below.
